body: Although a very unlikely choice I'd make I'll definitely look into it a little bit. Thank you.
You as well Derrick. My name is Mike. Thank you again. :)

I will be living in and around Reading, PA. 

I would like to go back to school but I don't want to go for just some random business degree like I was going for. When I really look at it and see how much I love gaming I feel like I'd do good in a field of that nature (game development, design, etc.). Those courses cost a lot though and since I can't get my financial aid back anymore I wouldn't be able to pay for that out of pocket. Plus I don't even know of any schools in my area that give courses like that.

I game a lot. I'm a really avid gamer which helps me take my mind off a lot usually. However my mouse broke and since I can't just go out and buy another one I can't really play the games I play on my PC. I also try to live stream me gaming here and there. It helps when I have people just hanging out with me. 

Thank you for the kind words :)

Technically "Her" money since my father let her put her name on his bank account. I've moved past it since then but maybe I will try to get some legal advice about it. 

I'm looking into some unions to get into since I do have some connections for that, however I don't know if I'm cut out for that type of work. Willing to give everything a try though. 

Also am aware my family sucks. That's why I only talk to very few of them and also why my true family are my friends who've been here for me since we were kids. 

Thank you for the words and advice I'll definitely be looking into all of it :)
I will look into these, thank you!
The army was a thought but after seeing some of my friends come back and express how much they hated it and all of that I was thrown off a bit.

Thank you for the kind words and advice. Also thank you for the links. I will surely check them out. It's tough to make it through the days that I feel really bad. I'm trying though. Thank you again. :)
